findings.problem: gxg_executions_total is exposed as a counter but is count(*) by current executions.state; reconcile moves outcome_unknown → reconciled_* (0001:343,428), so the series drops; Prometheus treats the drop as a reset and increase() > 0 — promtool with '2x30 1x30' fires GxgOutcomeUnknownGrowing at 40m; equal in/out between scrapes hides real growth
findings.required_improvement: make the outcome_unknown series monotonic (count executions that ever reached outcome_unknown: state IN ('outcome_unknown','reconciled_executed','reconciled_not_executed')), add a promtool case where a resolution does not fire and a new unknown does

findings.problem: a receiver that handled an event but whose 2xx was lost gets the same event_id again; kit verify raises replay, the model receiver answers 401, the notifier retries for 24 h with head-of-line ordering, so every later event of that subscriber waits and the delivered event finally goes dead with a false alert
findings.required_improvement: a validly signed, fresh, already-seen event_id is acknowledged (2xx) without re-processing: kit verify returns a duplicate marker (or documents reason 'replay' → 2xx), the test receiver does so, and a test shows lost-first-response → retry acknowledged → next event delivered

findings.ref: AS-30 «Assertion … хранится в decisions и проверяем задним числом»
findings.problem: the only revocation procedure for a lost/stolen passkey is DELETE of its webauthn_credentials row; the public key goes with it, so no decision that key signed can be verified later
findings.required_improvement: revoke by UPDATE webauthn_credentials SET enrolled_by = NULL (already refused by decider and gxg_decide, tested) and say in the runbook that the row is kept for later verification

findings.problem: gxg_reserve_conflicts_total on the executor's port 9101 is wired in _executor() and no test builds that registry or reads it (grep reserve_conflicts: no test); removing the register line keeps the suite green
findings.required_improvement: move the registry into a function (e.g. metrics.executor_registry()) and test that it exposes gxg_reserve_conflicts_total after a refused reserve

findings.ref: AS-27 (ui сверяет хеш canonical_args и не даёт решить при расхождении), EFF-33
findings.problem: the recorded decision is the one in the signed challenge, but the ui checks the envelope only if the form field decision == 'approve' and /challenge does not check it: challenge(approve) + POST decision=reject with that assertion records approve on an args/hash mismatch
findings.required_improvement: refuse decision=approve in /challenge when envelope(row) does not match; one test

findings.problem: a webhook secret file not readable by uid 10003 (e.g. root 0600 on the host bind mount) raises PermissionError from read_bytes; the loop catches only psycopg.Error, so the notifier exits and Telegram notifications stop too
findings.required_improvement: catch OSError in _secret → None (last_status 'no secret', as the runbook says); test with an unreadable file

findings.problem: admin fetches OIDC discovery and JWKS from GXG_ADMIN_OIDC_ISSUER without an https check (the ui has require_tls); an http issuer lets anyone on the path serve a JWKS and mint platform_admin tokens
findings.required_improvement: require https (loopback excepted) for the issuer and jwks_uri, reuse the ui's require_tls rule; one test

findings.ref: AS-30 («скомпрометированный ui … не может решить за человека»)
findings.problem: residual risks of the chosen design are not recorded: (a) WebAuthn shows no transaction content, so a compromised ui can feed an approve-challenge for intent B when the human clicks reject on A; (b) the invite passes through the ui, so a ui compromised while an invite is open can enroll its own key
findings.required_improvement: record both as known residual risks for owner acceptance (or the other AS-30 option) in reports/M10-PENDING-OWNER.md

findings.problem: no reports/conformance/M10.json; no mutmut report for the M10 Python modules added to only_mutate (decider, admin, metrics, sweeper, notifier webhooks, kit webhooks); reports/mutmut/M10-sql.txt holds the run with 5 survivors and only a sentence for the killing re-run
findings.required_improvement: commit M10.json with self_check, the mutmut output for the M10 modules (0 surviving non-equivalent), the full SQL mutation re-run output, and the AC-M10-06/07 reports

findings.problem: any https:// host is accepted (169.254.169.254, the postgres host on notifier_db); only the signed bundle and the compose networks stand between config and SSRF, and Signals itself will be RFC1918
findings.required_improvement: backlog: record «allowlist = network membership» as the SEC-15 decision for internal subscribers

findings.problem: gxg_api, gxg_sweeper, gxg_admin keep INSERT on outbox; a row topic='webhook' with any payload is signed by the notifier and sent to the subscriber (forged event from a compromised internal process)
findings.required_improvement: backlog (with the M9 outbox-topic item): writes of webhook rows only from the trigger (definer functions per topic or a CHECK on topic per role)

findings.problem: /metrics on api is unauthenticated; any process on the internal network (a connector of another tenant) reads per-tenant counts and subscriber ids
findings.required_improvement: backlog: scrape port separate from the service port or network-restricted

findings.problem: the stage-C report maps EX-01…24 only; the matrix lists EX-25 as stage C too
findings.required_improvement: backlog: add EX-25 to the stage-C report

required_improvements: F1: make the outcome_unknown series of gxg_executions_total monotonic (ever reached outcome_unknown) and add a promtool case: a resolution does not fire GxgOutcomeUnknownGrowing, a new unknown does

F2: acknowledge (2xx) a validly signed already-seen event_id without re-processing (kit verify duplicate marker or documented reason 'replay' → 2xx); update the test receiver; test lost-first-response → retry acknowledged → next event delivered
F3: runbook revocation by UPDATE webauthn_credentials SET enrolled_by = NULL instead of DELETE, with the reason (later verification of decisions, AS-30)
F4: test that the executor's metrics registry exposes gxg_reserve_conflicts_total
F5: /intents/{id}/challenge refuses decision=approve on an envelope/hash mismatch; one test
F6: notifier _secret returns None on OSError; test with an unreadable secret file
F7: admin requires an https issuer and jwks_uri (loopback excepted); one test
F8: add the two AS-30 residual risks (challenge substitution by a compromised ui; enrollment through the ui while an invite is open) to reports/M10-PENDING-OWNER.md

F9 + AC-M10-06/07: commit reports/conformance/M10.json (self_check), mutmut output for the M10 Python modules, full SQL mutation re-run output, reports/conformance/M10-mc05.md and reports/conformance/stage-C.json; green check-all.sh on the final commit
